test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

Human beings are usually ones who are __naturally able to eat both, plants and flesh.__
solution:
The correct answer is "**Omnivorous**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the **given words:**

 
 
• **Cannibals**: 

 a person who eats the flesh of other human beings.
 
 
• **Herbivorous**: 
 (of an animal) feeding on plants.
 
 
• **Carnivorous**: 
 (of an animal) feeding on other animals.
 
 
• **Omnivorous**: (of an animal or person) feeding on a variety of food of both plant and animal origin.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**omnivorous" **is the one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

**The correct sentence is:* ****Human beings are usually *the ones* who are **omnivorous.**.__*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**
